title: Wringer acquisition manifest
description: manifest.json of a `wring get` record — where a working copy came from. Schema version wringer.acquired.v1. A working copy that cannot say where it came from is the provenance gap P5 closes; this is the half of it that costs nothing today.

origin.description: The clone URL, as typed. Refused before the clone if it carried credentials, precisely because it is recorded here.

default_branch.description: The remote's default branch, or null when it could not be determined — which downstream is a refusal, never a guess.
